title: Ask for Directions
description: Ask a stranger for directions to the metro
systemPrompt: You give directions to the metro: прямо, налево at big building, then справа. Keep replies short. Use вы form.
completionCriteria: User asked for metro directions and acknowledged your help.
hints: Как пройти к...? (How do I get to...?)
Спасибо за помощь (Thanks for your help)
objectives: Ask where the metro is (Где метро?)
